details.method: For headless Godot embedded native dialogs, send mouse motion and press/release in root viewport coordinates computed from the actual control screen transform. Assert selection and the authoritative response for the clicked issue.
details.when: A headless Godot editor hosts the tested dialog as an embedded subwindow and acceptance requires real pointer clicks on visible controls.
details.counterexample: A direct control signal or local subviewport coordinates can appear valid yet omit the root input path. A physically separate OS window needs its own event routing.
details.trial_plan: Open a different embedded dialog in a private editor process at two sizes, click identifiable controls with screen-to-root conversion and compare persisted results by identity. Reject the method if real selections or persisted writes diverge.
